buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. DETAILED TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION FOR LADIES SHOES : 1.Nomenclature: Ladies safety foot wear 2.Basic requirements: (i)The ladies safety shoes shall be made of corrected grain (plain) leather, black in colour with full vamp P U (Polyurethane) Sole Oil and Acid Resistant, slip on sable design, Generally conforming to IS:15298 ( Par t 1 & 2): 2002 (ii)The fibre toe cap should be provided. (iii)The safety shoes shall be meant for general industrial pur pose use (for Ladies use). (iv)The firms(s) submitting their offer shall be ISO 9000 certified firms(s) and a certificate i n this regard must submitted along with offer, failling to fulfill this requirement, the offer will be ignored. 3.Compone nts requirements: (i)The thickness of Upper leather shall be 2.0+/- 2mm. (ii)One piece leather shall be used for Upp er. (iii)Chrome tanned softy leather lining shall be used for quarter. (iv)Cushioned lining shall be used for Vamp linin g. (v) Cushioned padded Collar(12mm Min) shall be provided. (vi)Socks padding of 3 mm ( min.) (vii)The Safety Shoe s shall withstand Electrical Shock proof up to 15 KV.4.Sole Requirements and material: (i) P U single density sole bla ck in colour (ii)The sole should be anti slip design with cleats depth 1.5mm ( Min.) (iii)The upper portion and sole of safety shoes shall be fixed together with DIP( Direct Injection Process) method/Stock on process. (iv)The sole should have hardness of 50 to 60 shores. 5.Thread: Nylon/Polyster thread of min. breading strength 3.5 kg.6. Tie Attachme nt: Single strap with one Velcro strip ( 3" long)7. Size: The size of shoes shall be as per English system.8.General Re quirements:(i) Shoes size, Month and Year of manufacture, manufacturers inner sole toward Heel side. (ii) The shoes shall be packed and supplied in cardboard with indication of size of shoes. II. SIZE AND QTY REQUIRED : Size : 4 - 4 pairs Size : 5 - 24 pairs , Size : 6 - 43 pairs , Size : 7 - 10 pairs , Size : 8 - 30 pairs , III Eligibility criteria : Offers from non manufacturers/ non MSEs/dealers/distributors will be summarily rejec ted. IV. The firms(s) submitting their offer shall be ISO 9000 certified firms(s) and a certificate in this regard must submit ted along with offer, failling to fulfill this requirement, the offer will be ignored.

V. Supply shall be made as per detailed technical specification mentioned above. VI. Advance sample approval : The successful bidder shall submit three pairs of samples duly complying wi t h the specifications to GSD/RWF for approval within 30 days of contract. VII. Guarantee certificate : 12 months from the date of supply VIII. Marking : In addition to the marking specified in IS 15298 (Part 2) 2002, Indian Railways logo has to b e embossed on outer quarter of each shoe. .
